# Corne (QMK) keyboard data

`info.json` and `rev1/keyboard.json` are copied unchanged from
https://github.com/qmk/qmk_firmware/tree/7a1bbf37c5c07da4ea0a162bb139083a46ef40a1/keyboards/crkbd (the commit the keyboard index is
generated from). QMK is GPL-2.0-or-later; its licence is `LICENSE` here. The derive tests read them in place of the network: a QMK
keyboard's layouts come from every `info.json` and `keyboard.json` on the way down from `keyboards/`.
